summary: This topic details how to create and manage different types of concession groups (e.g., Sibling, Staff Ward) in the system. Concessions can be defined by a percentage or a flat amount and applied across specific fee heads and installments.
steps: To create a new concession group, click 'New Concession Group'.
Enter the 'Concession Name' (e.g., Staff Ward Concession).
Select the 'Fee Head(s)' to which the concession applies (e.g., Annual Fees, or tick 'All Heads').
Enter the 'Percentage Value' (e.g., 50 for 50%) or 'Flat Value' (e.g., 5000).
business_rules: Concessions are session-dependent and can be copied from previous sessions.
Concessions are applied according to fee installments.
important_notes: Concession names are user-defined and not pre-set in the system.
The system allows defining concessions that apply to all fee heads or specific ones.
questions: How do I create a new concession group in the ERP system?
What types of concessions can I define (percentage or flat)?
Can I apply a concession to specific fee heads or all fee heads?
How do I copy concessions from a previous academic session?
